title: The Book of 1 Timothy Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 1 Timothy — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
verses.decoded: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the command of God our Savior and Lord Jesus Christ, who is our hope,

verses.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.decoded: To Timothy, my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.decoded: When I went to Macedonia, I asked you to stay in Ephesus and tell some people not to teach any other doctrine,

verses.kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
verses.decoded: and not to pay attention to myths and endless family histories that cause arguments instead of helping people have faith. Do this.

verses.kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
verses.decoded: The goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and sincere faith.

verses.kjv: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
verses.decoded: Some have turned away from these and have gotten involved in useless arguments.

verses.kjv: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.decoded: They want to be teachers of the law but do not understand what they are saying or what they believe.

verses.kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.decoded: We know the law is good if it is used properly by a person.

verses.kjv: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.decoded: We also know the law was made not for good people but for those who break the law, disobey, are ungodly and sinful, unholy and disrespectful, for murderers of parents,

verses.kjv: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
verses.decoded: for murderers, immoral people, those who have sex with men, kidnappers, liars, those who swear falsely, and for anything else that goes against true teaching,

verses.kjv: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.decoded: which agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God that was entrusted to me.

verses.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.decoded: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who gave me strength because he considered me faithful and appointed me to serve him.

verses.kjv: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.decoded: Before, I was a blasphemer, a persecutor, and violent, but I was shown mercy because I acted in ignorance and unbelief.

verses.kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: The grace of our Lord was very great, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.decoded: This saying is true and deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, and I am the worst of them all.

verses.kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.decoded: But because of this, I was shown mercy so that Jesus Christ would show his patience by using me as an example for those who would believe in him and receive eternal life.

verses.kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: Now to the eternal King, who cannot die, who is invisible, the only wise God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
verses.decoded: Timothy, my son, I give you this command based on the prophecies made about you earlier, so that by them you may fight the good fight,

verses.kjv: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.decoded: holding on to faith and a clear conscience. Some have rejected these and have ruined their faith.

verses.kjv: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.decoded: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan so they will learn not to speak against God.

verses.kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.decoded: So I urge that first of all, requests, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for everyone;

verses.kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
verses.decoded: for kings and all those in authority, so that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and honesty.

verses.kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
verses.decoded: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;

verses.kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.decoded: who wants everyone to be saved and to understand the truth.

verses.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.decoded: There is one God and one mediator between God and people, the man Christ Jesus;

verses.kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
verses.decoded: who gave himself as a ransom for all, which will be announced at the right time.

verses.kjv: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.decoded: I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth in Christ and not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

verses.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.decoded: So I want men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or arguing.

verses.kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
verses.decoded: In the same way, women should dress modestly, with decency and good sense, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothes;

verses.kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.decoded: but with good deeds, which are appropriate for women who claim to worship God.

verses.kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.decoded: Let a woman learn quietly and be fully submissive.

verses.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.decoded: I do not allow a woman to teach or to have authority over a man; she must be quiet.

verses.kjv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.decoded: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

verses.kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.decoded: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman was deceived and became a sinner.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
verses.decoded: But she will be saved through childbearing if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with good judgment.

verses.kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.decoded: This saying is true: If a man wants to be a leader in the church, he wants a good job.

verses.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.decoded: A leader must be blameless, married to only one wife, careful, self-controlled, well-behaved, welcoming to guests, and able to teach.

verses.kjv: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verses.decoded: He must not be addicted to wine, not violent, not greedy for money, but patient, not a fighter, and not greedy.

verses.kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.decoded: He must manage his own family well, with his children respecting him with proper behavior.

verses.kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.decoded: If a man does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God's church?

verses.kjv: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.decoded: He must not be a new believer, or he might become proud and fall into the devil's trap.

verses.kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.decoded: He must also have a good reputation with people outside the church, so he will not fall into disgrace and the devil's trap.

verses.kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.decoded: Deacons must be serious, not lying, not addicted to much wine, and not greedy for money.

verses.kjv: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.decoded: They must keep their faith pure and sincere.

verses.kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
verses.decoded: Let them be tested first; then if they are blameless, let them serve as deacons.

verses.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.decoded: Their wives must also be serious, not gossipers, selfcontrolled, and faithful in everything.

verses.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.decoded: Deacons must be husbands of only one wife and must manage their children and homes well.

verses.kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: Those who serve well as deacons earn a good reputation and great confidence in their faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
verses.decoded: I am writing these things to you, hoping to come to you soon.

verses.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.decoded: But if I am delayed, I want you to know how to behave in God's household, which is the church of the living God, the foundation and support of the truth.

verses.kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.decoded: There is no doubt that the mystery of godliness is great: God was shown in human form, made right by the Spirit, seen by angels, preached to the nations, believed in throughout the world, and taken up to glory.

verses.kjv: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.decoded: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some people will leave the faith and follow false spirits and teachings from demons.

verses.kjv: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.decoded: They will lie and act hypocritically, having their conscience completely burned and insensitive.

verses.kjv: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.decoded: They will forbid marriage and tell people not to eat certain foods, which God created to be received with thanks by those who believe and know the truth.

verses.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.decoded: Every creature God made is good and should not be rejected if it is accepted with thanks.

verses.kjv: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.decoded: It is made holy by God's word and prayer.

verses.kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.decoded: If you remind the believers of these things, you will be a good servant of Jesus Christ, growing strong in the faith and good teaching you have received.

verses.kjv: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
verses.decoded: Avoid worthless stories and old wives’ tales, and instead train yourself to be godly.

verses.kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.decoded: Physical exercise is of little value, but being godly is valuable in every way, promising benefits for this life and the life to come.

verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.decoded: This saying is trustworthy and deserves full acceptance.

verses.kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.decoded: That is why we work hard and endure insults, because we trust the living God, who saves everyone, especially those who believe.

verses.kjv: These things command and teach.
verses.decoded: Teach and command these things.

verses.kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.decoded: Don’t let anyone look down on you because you are young. Instead, be an example to the believers in what you say, how you live, your love, your faith, and your purity.

verses.kjv: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.decoded: Until I come, focus on reading the Scriptures, encouraging others, and teaching.

verses.kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.decoded: Don’t neglect the gift you received when the elders laid their hands on you and prophesied.

verses.kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
verses.decoded: Think about these things carefully and devote yourself to them, so that everyone can see your progress.

verses.kjv: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verses.decoded: Watch your life and your teaching closely. Stay true to both, because by doing this you will save yourself and those who listen to you.

verses.kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
verses.decoded: Do not sharply correct an older man, but speak to him as you would to a father; treat younger men like brothers.

verses.kjv: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.decoded: Treat older women like mothers, and younger women like sisters, with complete purity.

verses.kjv: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.decoded: Respect widows who are truly widows.

verses.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
verses.decoded: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should first learn to care for their own family and repay their parents, because this pleases God.

verses.kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.decoded: A real widow who is alone trusts God and spends her time praying day and night.

verses.kjv: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
verses.decoded: But a woman who lives only for pleasure is spiritually dead even while she lives.

verses.kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.decoded: Give these instructions so that no one can find fault with you.

verses.kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.decoded: If anyone does not take care of their own family, especially their own household, they have denied the faith and are worse than an unbeliever.

verses.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.decoded: No widow should be accepted into the group unless she is at least sixty years old and has been married only once.

verses.kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.decoded: She must be well known for doing good things: raising children, welcoming strangers, washing the feet of believers, helping those in trouble, and always doing good.

verses.kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
verses.decoded: But reject younger widows, because when they become sexually active against Christ, they want to get married.

verses.kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.decoded: They are condemned because they have abandoned their first faith.

verses.kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.decoded: Besides, they learn to be lazy, wandering from house to house; they are not only lazy but also gossipers and busybodies who say things they should not.

verses.kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.decoded: So I want younger women to marry, have children, manage their homes, and not give the enemy any reason to criticize them.

verses.kjv: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.decoded: Some have already turned away to follow Satan.

verses.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.decoded: If any believer has widows in their family, they should help them so the church is not burdened, and the church can care for widows who are truly in need.

verses.kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.decoded: Elders who lead well should be given double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.

verses.kjv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
verses.decoded: For the scripture says, 'You must not stop an ox from eating while it is working.' And, 'A worker deserves to be paid.'

verses.kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
verses.decoded: Do not accept an accusation against an elder unless there are two or three witnesses.

verses.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.decoded: Correct those who sin publicly so that others will be afraid to do wrong.

verses.kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.decoded: I charge you before God, Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels to keep these rules without showing favoritism or partiality.

verses.kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.decoded: Do not lay hands on anyone too quickly or share in other people's sins. Keep yourself pure.

verses.kjv: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
verses.decoded: Some people’s sins are obvious and lead to judgment, while others’ sins follow them later.

verses.kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.decoded: In the same way, some people’s good deeds are obvious ahead of time, but others cannot be hidden.

verses.kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.decoded: All servants who are under authority should respect their masters fully, so that God's name and teaching are not insulted.

verses.kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
verses.decoded: Those with believing masters should not disrespect them because they are brothers, but serve them well because they are faithful and loved, sharing in the benefits. Teach and encourage these things.

verses.kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.decoded: If anyone teaches differently and does not agree with healthy words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that leads to godliness,

verses.kjv: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
verses.decoded: that person is proud and knows nothing. They argue about questions and words, which cause jealousy, fights, insults, and evil suspicions.

verses.kjv: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
verses.decoded: They argue in wrong ways with corrupt minds and no truth, thinking that being rich is godliness. Stay away from people like that.

verses.kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.decoded: But being godly and content is great wealth.

verses.kjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.decoded: We came into this world with nothing, and we will leave with nothing.

verses.kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
verses.decoded: So if we have food and clothes, we should be satisfied with that.

verses.kjv: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.decoded: But those who want to be rich fall into temptation and traps, and many foolish and harmful desires that destroy people.

verses.kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.decoded: The love of money is the root of all evil. Some have wanted money so much that they have left the faith and hurt themselves with many sorrows.

verses.kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.decoded: But you, man of God, run away from all that. Instead, pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and gentleness.

verses.kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.decoded: Fight the good fight of faith. Hold on to eternal life, which you were called to and have openly declared before many witnesses.

verses.kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
verses.decoded: I command you before God, who gives life to everything, and before Christ Jesus, who made a good confession before Pontius Pilate,

verses.kjv: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.decoded: to keep this command without fault until our Lord Jesus Christ appears.

verses.kjv: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
verses.decoded: He will show himself at the right time. He is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

verses.kjv: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
verses.decoded: He alone has eternal life and lives in light that no one can come near. No one has seen him or can see him. Honor and power belong to him forever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
verses.decoded: Tell the rich people in this world not to be proud or trust in their uncertain wealth, but to trust in the living God, who gives us richly everything to enjoy.

verses.kjv: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
verses.decoded: Tell them to do good, be rich in good works, be generous, and willing to share.

verses.kjv: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.decoded: By doing this, they will save a good foundation for themselves for the future, so they can hold on to eternal life.

verses.kjv: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
verses.decoded: Timothy, guard what has been trusted to you. Stay away from foolish and empty talk and from arguments based on false knowledge.

verses.kjv: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen. The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.
verses.decoded: Some who claim to know this have wandered away from the faith. May grace be with you. Amen.
